verdict.rationale: Warp's documented API is a company-scoped integration API: one API key per company, used to read and write that company's own HR and payroll data. Nothing in the evidence describes a partner or multi-tenant API, white-label UI components, or embedding payroll for a developer's own customers. An internal-data integration API is an adjacent capability, not embedded white-label payroll.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API
